clue.text: Brave possessing attitude

parts.note: possessing something means being with it, as in 'a man with money'
an attitude or position on an issue is a stand

explanation.surface: A courageous person holds a firm attitude.
explanation.definitionFit: To brave something is to face and resist it without giving way, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Violent infringement of rule reported in game

parts.note: wild means violent, unrestrained

indicators.note: reported means said aloud and heard as another word

parts.note: a foul is a breach of the rules in sport

explanation.surface: A violent foul is called during a match.
explanation.definitionFit: Wildfowl are birds hunted for sport, which is game in the hunting sense.

clue.text: Complete deal set up to accommodate an army

indicators.note: accommodate means the word holds the other within it
in a down clue set up means written upwards, reversed

parts.note: a lot is a deal, as in 'a great deal'
TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's reserve force

explanation.surface: A complete deal is arranged to house troops.
explanation.definitionFit: Total as an adjective means complete or entire.

clue.text: Unexpectedly prove a sun is an exploding star

indicators.note: unexpectedly suggests the letters appear in a surprising order

explanation.surface: Contrary to expectation, the sun is shown to be a star that explodes.
explanation.definitionFit: A supernova is the catastrophic explosion of a massive star.

clue.text: Terrified, seeing gangster with gun

parts.note: Al Capone is the archetypal gangster
armed means carrying a gun

explanation.surface: Seeing a gangster with a gun leaves someone scared.
explanation.definitionFit: Alarmed means frightened or disturbed, an adjective synonym.

clue.text: Hardy bachelor's deserting of the French mob

parts.note: du is French for 'of the'

indicators.note: deserting means the bachelor's letter leaves the word

parts.note: a rabble is a disorderly mob
B is the abbreviation for bachelor

explanation.surface: A tough bachelor walks out on the French mob.
explanation.definitionFit: Durable things are tough and long-lasting, as hardy things are.

clue.text: Borders where combat took place?

definitions.meaning: edges or selvages of cloth, the strips along a fabric's margin
the enclosed grounds where medieval knights jousted in tournaments

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are dictionary meanings: cloth edges, and the fenced arena for tilting in tournaments.

clue.text: Compare Liberal leader with single man

indicators.note: leader takes the opening letter of Liberal

parts.note: I, the Roman numeral, is one, a single
Ken is a man's name

explanation.surface: Contrast the Liberal party's leader with a bachelor.
explanation.definitionFit: To liken one thing to another is to compare them, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Press magnate inviting daughter in for drink after work?

indicators.note: inviting someone in means taking them inside, so the letter goes within

parts.note: the owner of the Sun newspaper is a press magnate

explanation.surface: A newspaper tycoon has his daughter round for a drink after the office.
explanation.walkthrough: A sundowner is a drink at sunset, when the working day ends.
explanation.definitionFit: A sundowner is an evening drink taken at sunset, after the day's work.

clue.text: Dwell on top of slope overlooking lock

indicators.note: in a down clue overlooking means sitting above the next piece
top of takes the first letter of slope

parts.note: a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: Lingering at the head of a slope with a view of a canal lock.
explanation.definitionFit: To stress a point is to emphasise it, to dwell on it.

clue.text: Model finally given topless dress for relaxation

indicators.note: finally points to the closing letter of the word model
topless says the top letter of the synonym is removed

parts.note: a get-up is an outfit or dress

explanation.surface: A model is finally handed a revealing outfit so she can unwind.
explanation.definitionFit: A let-up is a pause or easing off, a noun synonym for relaxation.

clue.text: Citizen on a day's run, one of Dutch descent

indicators.note: in an across clue, on means placed after the preceding pieces

parts.note: Fri is the short form of Friday, a day
Citizen Kane is the famous Orson Welles film, so Citizen leads to Kane
R is the cricket scoring abbreviation for a run

explanation.surface: A citizen out for a day's jog turns out to have Dutch roots.
explanation.walkthrough: Citizen leads to KANE by way of the film title Citizen Kane.
explanation.definitionFit: Afrikaners are South Africans descended mainly from Dutch settlers.

clue.text: Almost complete measure binding rugby prop

indicators.note: almost means the word is cut short of its final letter

parts.note: complete means full

indicators.note: binding means the measure wraps around the rugby piece

parts.note: cm, a centimetre, is a measure
RU stands for Rugby Union

explanation.surface: A rugby prop forward almost wraps up the full measure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rugby prop' reads as the front-row forward; prop is really the definition, a support.
explanation.definitionFit: A fulcrum is the pivot or support on which a lever turns, a prop.

clue.text: Retired aristocrat repairs drums

indicators.note: retired means withdrawn, going backwards, so the word is reversed

parts.note: a nob is a toff, an aristocrat
to repair to a place is to go there

explanation.surface: A retired nobleman spends his time fixing drums.
explanation.definitionFit: Bongos are small hand drums played in pairs, here in a variant plural spelling.

clue.text: Light bandage? It's for show

parts.note: a window is a light, letting light into a room
a dressing is a bandage on a wound

explanation.surface: A flimsy bandage is just for appearances.
explanation.definitionFit: Window dressing means a presentation designed to look good, done for appearances only.

clue.text: Blow dealt by old PM meeting king in city?

parts.note: Lord North was British Prime Minister in the 18th century

indicators.note: in places the king's letter inside the city

parts.note: Ely is a cathedral city in Cambridgeshire
R, for rex, is king

explanation.surface: A blow struck by a former Prime Minister meeting the king in a city.
explanation.walkthrough: Blow is a noun here: a wind from the north.
explanation.definitionFit: A northerly is a wind from the north, and a blow is a gale.

clue.text: Oxford producer has drink right outside new home

indicators.note: outside means the drink and right letter go around the other piece

parts.note: sake is Japanese rice wine

indicators.note: new suggests the letters of home in a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: An Oxford manufacturer drinks just beyond his newly built house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New' rearranges home, and SAKE with R goes around it. An oxford is a laced leather shoe, so the producer makes footwear.
explanation.definitionFit: An oxford is a style of laced shoe, so its maker is a cobbler.

clue.text: Booth, for example, with two hoofed mammals in

parts.note: an ass is a hoofed mammal, and two give it twice
the second of the two hoofed beasts, another ass

explanation.surface: A theatre booth housing a pair of donkeys.
explanation.walkthrough: John Wilkes Booth shot President Lincoln.
explanation.definitionFit: John Wilkes Booth killed Abraham Lincoln, so he is an example of a killer of a public figure.

clue.text: What actors do about publicity directors cut way back

indicators.note: the reversed road word is cut open to take the other pieces
back means the word for way is read in reverse

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
re means about, concerning
an ad is a piece of publicity
the board are a company's directors

explanation.surface: Actors talk about publicity while company directors trim their route.
explanation.definitionFit: To tread the boards is the idiom for performing on stage as an actor.

clue.text: Dissertation about origin of prominent Greek poet

indicators.note: about means the dissertation surrounds the next letter

parts.note: a thesis is a dissertation

indicators.note: origin of takes the opening letter of prominent

explanation.surface: An academic paper on how a famous Greek poet began.
explanation.definitionFit: Thespis was the ancient Greek poet credited as the first actor of tragedy.

clue.text: Some heard rumours-through this agency?

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some rumours are heard through a particular channel.
explanation.definitionFit: Sounds, including rumours, are heard by means of the membrane in the ear.

clue.text: Aquatic mammal identified by every person in boat

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation inside the boat

parts.note: a scow is a flat-bottomed boat
ea. abbreviates each, meaning per person

explanation.surface: An aquatic creature is spotted by everyone on board.
explanation.definitionFit: A sea cow is a manatee or dugong, a plant-eating marine mammal.

clue.text: Quarters he can possibly improve

indicators.note: possibly signals the letters may be arranged another way

parts.note: north and east are quarters, compass points

explanation.surface: Lodgings that he may be able to do up.
explanation.definitionFit: To enhance something is to raise its quality, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Sort of weather pin-up found extremely parky

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word reads upwards, reversed
extremely takes the outermost letters of parky

explanation.surface: A pin-up model turns out rather cold.
explanation.walkthrough: Parky is British slang for chilly; the 'pin-up' hyphen hides 'pin' reversed by 'up'.
explanation.definitionFit: Nippy weather is chilly or cold, a describing word for a kind of day.

clue.text: Rich cake graduate served at end of dance

indicators.note: the graduate piece is placed after the dance

parts.note: the rumba is a Cuban dance
BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a graduate

explanation.surface: A rich cake is served to a graduate after the dance.
explanation.definitionFit: A rum baba is a rich yeast cake soaked in rum syrup.

clue.text: Investigate uranium in entrance to mine

indicators.note: in places the uranium symbol inside the entrance

parts.note: an adit is a horizontal entrance to a mine
U is the chemical symbol for uranium

explanation.surface: Investigators search for uranium at a mine entrance.
explanation.definitionFit: To audit accounts is to examine and investigate them officially.

clue.text: Hairdressing aid left wrapped in dog magazine

indicators.note: the abbreviation for left sits inside the other two words

parts.note: a cur is a mongrel dog
a paper is a periodical publication

explanation.surface: A hair curler has been left rolled up inside a dog magazine.
explanation.definitionFit: A curl-paper is a strip of paper hair is wound round to set curls.

clue.text: Glory university don initially found in Aegean island

indicators.note: found in says the pieces sit inside the island's name

parts.note: Kos is a Greek island in the Aegean

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter of don

explanation.surface: A university don earns glory for a discovery on a Greek island.
explanation.definitionFit: Kudos means honour or prestige, praise won by achievement, a noun synonym.

clue.text: How mockers regard one with his carefree life, say

indicators.note: say signals that the word is spoken and heard as another

parts.note: the idiom 'the life of Riley' means a carefree life

explanation.surface: Mockers sneer at a man who lives a carefree existence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The life of Riley' is an idiom for an easy, carefree existence.
explanation.definitionFit: Mockers look on in a dry, ironic, sardonic manner, which is the adverb's sense.

clue.text: Good person returning as maid? About time

indicators.note: returning means read backwards
about means wrapped around the next piece

parts.note: Maid Marian is Robin Hood's companion

explanation.surface: A kindly person comes back, perhaps as a maid, after some time.
explanation.walkthrough: MARIAN comes from Maid Marian of the Robin Hood legends.
explanation.definitionFit: From the parable of the Good Samaritan, the word means a charitable helper.
